content.about: Mozambique runs along Africa's southeast coast, with a long Indian Ocean shoreline. Beaches, coral reefs and islands line its coast. The Zambezi River crosses its middle. Its flag is the only one showing a modern rifle.

standout.text: The Bazaruto Archipelago is one of the last strongholds of the dugong in the western Indian Ocean.

didYouKnow: Mozambique Island was once the capital of Portuguese East Africa.
Whale sharks and manta rays visit Tofo beach.
